item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei: Supreme Leader Dead, Iran TV Confirms as 40-Day Mourning Declared

item.title: Minor Damage Reported at Bahrain Airport
item.description: Bahrain International Airport was targeted by a drone today, resulting in some material damage but no casualties. Authorities are currently taking necessary measures to secure the site and ensure the safety of airport operations. Investigations are underway to determine the details of the incident. Also Read : Russia Condemns US Attack on Iran, Warns of Possible ‘Radiological Catastrophe’

item.title: UAE Suspends Flights for Drones, Gliders and Recreational Aircraft for One Week
item.description: The General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) has issued a directive suspending all flight permits for gliders, unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), and recreational aircraft of all types, effective immediately and for a period of one week. item.title: Four Injured As Government Hospitals Raise Emergency Readiness
item.description: Government Hospitals announced that amid the ongoing hostile attack targeting the Kingdom of Bahrain, four injured individuals were received at Salmaniya Medical Complex. According to officials, three of the cases were minor and were treated in line with approved medical protocols before being discharged. item.title: Missile Barrage Shakes Gulf As Iran Retaliates, Airports And Bases Targeted
item.description: Explosions rocked cities across the Gulf on Saturday, killing two people in Abu Dhabi, while smoke and flames rose from Dubai landmark The Palm as Iran launched waves of attacks in retaliation for US and Israeli strikes.
